title: DOUDY

If you are convinced by the purchase of DOUDY I would like to remind you that I am very passionate to make this game. 

It’s not a blockbuster with hours and hours of content. 

I just want to offer you a game that will allow you to explore, 
to discover the story DOUDY, 
in a psychologically horrifying walking simulator 
while providing enough depth for players who want to add some spice. 
PS / the keys can be modified ...

And all for the price of a cheap pizza ... :)
